$comment: Single source of truth for First Bank brand tokens on the pie-fundraiser project. The game, the PDF generators, and the screen mockups all read from here. Brand colors sampled from public assets on fbvirginia.com 2026-09-01; stage colors sampled from the shipped app 2026-09-01.

brand.name: First Bank
brand.relationship: client brand, used with permission pending

sampled.method: logo SVG fill values and site stylesheet color frequency

red.usage: section heads, primary buttons, accent rules, active states

red_dark.usage: hover and pressed states, callout text on light red

charcoal.usage: body text, table headers, cover background

confirm.source: derived, not a First Bank color

stage.$comment: The arena background behind the avatar. Deeper reds than the corporate palette so the navy suit and white cream read against it. Sampled from the shipped app, not from fbvirginia.com.
stage.pattern: checkerboard, medallion on the dark tiles only

tile_dark.usage: checker dark square, carries the medallion

medallion_ink.usage: medallion ring and numeral — warm light gray, deliberately NOT pure white

floor.usage: floor band the avatar stands on

stage.note: None of these are First Bank corporate colors. They are a stage treatment derived from the brand, and Marketing may want a say.

positive.status: derived locally by recoloring the reverse artwork's white fills to charcoal
positive.action: request official positive artwork from Marketing and replace

logo.clearspace: keep at least the height of the '1' mark clear on all sides
never: do not stretch or recolor the mark outside the two variants above
do not place the reverse logo on a light background
do not typeset the wordmark manually

document.note: PDF generation. Substitute the bank's corporate face if Marketing supplies one.

interface.note: Geometric sans, closest available match to the logo wordmark. Mockups only; confirm before production.

known_issues.note: Game was built before official artwork was pulled. Darker and cooler than the real corporate red.
No positive-artwork SVG is published publicly; current file is a local recolor.
Mockup originally used a flat #DFE9F2 sky, which was never in the app. Rebuilt against the real checkered stage; the medallion is lifted from an app capture rather than redrawn.

consumers.what: briefing PDF palette, cover, page headers
arena mockup — reads the stage block

usage_position: These are First Bank's public brand assets, applied so the committee sees the concept in familiar colors. No claim of ownership or endorsement. If Marketing has an internal brand standard, it supersedes this file.
